Subject: Regulatory Notice SCA-2026-0718 – Written Response Required

Dear the firm,

Pursuant to Consumer Protection Code s. 12-401, this office issues notice SCA-2026-0718 and requires the following:

1. Submit a written response within ten (10) calendar days of receipt of this notice.  
2. Preserve all records, documents, and electronic data pertinent to the matters described in the attached notice until a response is provided.  
3. Direct any questions to the contact identified in the notice.

Respectfully,  
R. Patel  
Office of Consumer Affairs
